content:
name: A2-DYN physical roof variation native build

'on':
  push:
    branches:
      - revision/a2-dyn-physical-roof-variation-2026-10-21
    paths:
      - 'papers/A2-DYN-physical-roof-variation-author-revision/**'
      - '.github/workflows/a2-dyn-physical-roof-variation-20261021.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  native-source-checks-and-build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
        working-directory: papers/A2-DYN-physical-roof-variation-author-revision
    env:
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
      OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS: '1'
      OMP_NUM_THREADS: '1'
    steps:
      - name: Check out the exact author revision
        uses: actions/checkout@fbc6f3992d24b796d5a048ff273f7fcc4a7b6c09 # v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            .github/workflows
            papers/A2-DYN-physical-roof-variation-author-revision

      - name: Record the actual checkout
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p build/current
          git rev-parse HEAD > build/current/CI_CHECKOUT_SHA.txt
          sha256sum build.sh requirements.txt ci/a2-dyn-physical-roof-variation-20261021.yml > build/current/CI_ENTRYPOINT_SHA256.txt

      - name: Set up Python 3.12
        uses: actions/setup-python@ece7cb06caefa5fff74198d8649806c4678c61a1 # v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: papers/A2-DYN-physical-roof-variation-author-revision/requirements.txt

      - name: Install native TeX and pinned mathematical dependencies
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
            texlive-latex-base texlive-latex-recommended texlive-latex-extra \
            texlive-fonts-recommended texlive-science lmodern poppler-utils
          python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --no-input -r requirements.txt
          python3 -c 'import sys; sys.exit(0 if sys.version_info[:2] == (3, 12) else 1)'
          {
            python3 --version
            python3 -m pip freeze
            pdflatex --version
            pdfinfo -v
          } > build/current/CI_ENVIRONMENT.log 2>&1

      - name: Rebuild and verify the complete native author revision
        id: native_build
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bash build.sh 2>&1 | tee build/current/CI_BUILD.log

      - name: Retain the actual run outcome
        if: always()
        env:
          A2_DYN_BUILD_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.native_build.outcome }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p build/current
          printf '%s\n' "$A2_DYN_BUILD_OUTCOME" > build/current/CI_BUILD_OUTCOME.txt
          git rev-parse HEAD > build/current/CI_CHECKOUT_SHA.txt
          git status --porcelain=v1 > build/current/CI_POST_RUN_STATUS.txt

      - name: Upload actual current and historical build records
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@b7c566a772e6b6bfb58ed0dc250532a479d7789f # v6
        with:
          name: a2-dyn-physical-roof-variation-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            papers/A2-DYN-physical-roof-variation-author-revision/build/current/
            papers/A2-DYN-physical-roof-variation-author-revision/build/current-history/execution/
            papers/A2-DYN-physical-roof-variation-author-revision/build/current-history/*.pdf
            papers/A2-DYN-physical-roof-variation-author-revision/build/current-history/REBUILD_SUMMARY.json
            papers/A2-DYN-physical-roof-variation-author-revision/build/current-history/rebuild.stdout.log
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90
          compression-level: 6
          overwrite: false
